parsed_reminder:
The task explicitly requires "checks that catch cases of non-log-concave densities during the sampling process." Disabling the check entirely violates this requirement.

Your diagnosis is correct: tangent line extrapolation has large errors over distances of 5-10 units. But rather than removing the check, consider alternatives that preserve the requirement:
- Check only against the nearest 1-2 points instead of all segments
- Use distance-weighted tolerance: tolerance proportional to |x_new - x[i]|
- Apply the check only when adding new abscissae, not during every sample
- Use second derivatives or alternative concavity tests

The check needs to exist and catch actual non-log-concave cases, even if it needs to be more lenient to avoid false positives on valid distributions.
